message:
Anonymous -- as you've seen, it's all about defining the term "technology." Maybe Google doesn't help learning: thousands of years ago, Plato wrote the [Phaedrus](http://books.mirror.org/plato/phaedrus/), which was all about the fancy new technology of writing, and its educational possibilities. He wasn't optimistic.

Maybe a better question might be: what educational software products are being offered to which students -- and why do the other students 'refuse' those products?
